expectation_rules.capture: Every $identity is captured from actual successful response or uniquely corresponding committed row, validated as UUID and linked across SQL/history/facts/readback; never synthesize UUIDs or event times.
expectation_rules.failures: Current Go D25 translation and decisions.md E2 use apierr value mapped to extensions.code; never invent a Python union or successful empty fallback. Coercion/scalar failure executes zero authority/business SQL.
expectation_rules.readback: S04 invokes each referenced exact effect/readback group after success through the mounted API and fresh SQL transaction. A source selector admits only its fixture/before values; this artifact variables and selected response are the actual action.
expectation_rules.rollback: Every failing fresh case preserves complete reset fixture table snapshots including existing immutable histories. Receipt failure is injected after effect writes but before commit, no partial receipt escapes.
expectation_rules.replay: Recheck current authority before receipt disclosure. Same actor/operation/key/canonical payload reuses committed result and all captured identities/times; zero repeated effects/HTTP. Different canonical payload under same scope CONFLICT.
expectation_rules.canonical_json: P01 product.Fingerprint receives the deterministically validated transport-independent Spec before DB-dependent normalization or current-command generated IDs/time. Marshal typed Spec, decode entire JSON tree with UseNumber, then encoding/json.Marshal(tree), using default HTML escaping and sorted object keys. Preserve json.Number lexemes, array order and string bytes; 1 and1.0 may differ. Patch Set/Value distinguishes omitted/null; full replacement normalizes those per owning input. Scalar UUID/DateTime/Time normalization precedes hash. Fingerprint is lowercase hex SHA256 of those bytes. Actor and operation are separate scope keys; meta is excluded.
expectation_rules.isolation: Every fresh case owns a new approved migrated S03 fixture database. after_case chains alone reuse a committed positive. No runtime services or broad QA population are silently assumed.

input_validation_refs.rule: The actual current-SDL complete input object is in every new command. Referenced accepted field cases supply fixture/value provenance only; their former command/action is not adopted. Leaf-field boundary criteria remain separately required and are not counted by these root-argument groups.

variations.array_reorder: different canonical bytes when array is order-bearing
variations.number_1_vs_1point0: lexemes may differ; no numeric-form equivalence promised
